gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: A funky, closed-up outline gives Groovy its whole personality, every stroke as thick as the next. And Noto Sans Tai Le stays open and tapered, a plain sans that lets the lettering breathe.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Noto Sans Tai Tham reads like chalk-board lowercase, crowded toward the capital line, with every c clearly open to the eye. Groovy's loose, friendly letters sit above it without crowding.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Groovy has tails and terminals as heavy as its stems, nearly shut curves and a goofy grin of a texture. But Noto Sans Tai Viet pulls its terminals back, leaving a tall x-height and open curves that feel brisk and approachable.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-takri: Noto Sans Takri leaves every small round letter generously unclosed, with a high-waisted lowercase that looks lifted. Groovy keeps its strokes uniform, with no calligraphic swell, which is where it earns its keep when big and short, while Noto Sans Takri stays a sans of quiet openness.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement reads stocky, its rounds like open parentheses. Groovy's loosely tracked, nearly closed letters give that tall middle band a playful partner, funky above and clean below.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa opens its round letters wide, with short ascender stems rising from tall lowercase bodies. And over many lines it would feel inviting and unhurried, a sans-serif that never fights the eye.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC reads with large open counters in a, e and s, its curves flaring outward rather than curling in. And Groovy's pen line, which holds one width throughout, feels friendly and funky beside that openness.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu reads with a high-set midline and counters open to the outside. Groovy's thread-thin curves, drawn at one thickness, give the pair its strongest quality, a loose and friendly contrast between a closed display face and an open sans-serif.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Groovy's narrow slit, where the c almost closes, is the first thing you notice. But Noto Sans Thaana answers with wide channels into each counter, so the funky top line gets a roomy, approachable plain sans beneath it.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-thai: Groovy tightens its letters into almost-closed shapes with loose tracking and a friendly, funky bounce. But Noto Sans Thai swells its lowercase like inflated glass beads and leaves each round open, so paragraphs would feel soft and easygoing.
